decision: The competitor (Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport) is fined €600.
event_name: Mercedes AMG Petronas Motorsport Document 30 Date 27 July 2019 Time 15:41 2019 GERMAN GRAND PRIX 25 - 28 July 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Car 77 exceeded the pit lane speed limit which is set at 80 km/h for this Event by 5.4 km/h.
rules_referenced: Article 22.10 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
